governance: SEC-18: every third-party SDK that ships in a client artifact (client/ — iOS, Android, Flutter, web) must appear in this list before merge. The CI gate (scripts/check_sdk_allowlist.py via the sdk-allowlist job) is fail-closed: a dependency with no matching entry fails the build. Entries are added by PR with the justification and data-access review recorded inline; removal of an entry without removing the dependency also fails the build.

fields.name: package identity in its ecosystem (npm package name, pub.dev package, CocoaPods pod, Maven group:artifact)
fields.versionConstraint: exact version or caret/tilde range the client manifest must satisfy
fields.dataAccess: what personal data the SDK can touch — drives the SEC-12 DPIA linkage
